name: 布噜浏览器
description: Drive a real Chrome browser: open pages, read page structure, click, type, screenshot, and inspect network requests.
description_zh: 用本机真实 Chrome 打开网页、读取页面结构与可交互元素、点击输入、整页截图，并抓取页面网络请求和 console 日志。登录态保存在独立 profile 中，重启后依然有效。
description_en: Drive a real Chrome on your machine: open pages, read page structure and interactive elements, click, type, take full-page screenshots, and inspect network requests and console logs. Login state persists in an isolated profile.
examples_zh: 打开 example.com，把这个页面的主要内容读给我
帮我在这个网页里把搜索框填上关键词并提交，然后告诉我结果
截个图给我看当前页面长什么样
看看这个页面调用了哪些接口，把最新那条请求的返回结构给我
examples_en: Open example.com and summarize the main content of the page
Fill in the search box on this page with a keyword, submit it, and tell me the results
Take a screenshot so I can see what the current page looks like
List the API requests this page made and show me the response body of the latest one
